reason: This is a broad refactor of core planner infrastructure, not a narrow local fix. It touches the central `Plan`/task abstractions, physical optimization flow (`optimizer.go`, `find_best_task.go`, `task*.go`), and cost-model helpers across 40+ planner files. Even if intended as code movement/interface cleanup, splitting planner interfaces and relocating cost/optimization utilities can silently break optimizer contracts, costing, or rule behavior with high blast radius.
